facts.fact: Kayla 撕碎与 Aaron 的旧照：不敢相信曾以为爱他
facts.anchor: I can’t believe I thought I loved this man

facts.fact: 阁楼曾是她拚来的「自己的地方」，如今她只想回家
facts.anchor: I spent so long making sure I had a place that was mine, but now I’m here and I just want to go home

facts.fact: 亲密中 Ares 主动放弃控制节奏：这次不是操纵，她想给什么就给什么
Ares 定义爱：无议程地想让对方拥有所需——他或许一直有能力
facts.anchor: maybe I have been capable of love the whole time

facts.fact: 他对「I love you」的回应：我没有同样的词，但我能力所及的一切都是你的
facts.anchor: I don’t have the same words you do, but whatever I’m capable of, it’s yours

facts.fact: Ares 内心交代：监护人渣滓、虐待史绝不重提——全书唯一一次自曝
facts.anchor: My guardian was a piece of shit, and the abuse along with everything else they put me through is not something I will ever rehash

facts.fact: 搬家尾声他对她说：我愿跟你下地狱，她笑因她知道是真话
facts.anchor: I would follow you into the pits of hell

facts.fact: 章末 Kayla 醒来说：生平第一次，真的感觉「到家了」
facts.anchor: For the first time in my life, it really feels like I am
